title.narrative: Resilient Young Farmers Initiative for Sustainability and Empowerment

description.narrative: The Resilient Young Farmers Initiative for Sustainability and Empowerment (RISE) is implemented by the Young Farmers Federation of Uganda (UNYFA) across eight districts in Central and Eastern Uganda. Positioned within Uganda's broader youth and agricultural transformation agenda, UNYFA is a national platform for strengthening youth leadership, improving services for young farmers, and revitalizing the agricultural sector. RISE responds to Uganda's urgent demographic pressure, where youth make up over 70% of the population yet remain excluded from land, finance, agribusiness opportunities, and climate-smart technologies. The initiative directly targets 800 young farmers, at least half women and marginalized youth, to strengthen youth-led farmer associations, advance climate-resilient livelihoods, and promote equitable participation in local food systems. The project focuses on five strategic areas: (1) strengthening governance and advocacy capacity of 30 youth groups and District Young Farmer Associations; (2) promoting climate-smart, market-oriented agribusiness through the Enabling Rural Innovation model; (3) enhancing climate and economic resilience via conservation hubs, circular economy enterprises, and adaptation planning; (4) advancing gender equality and inclusion; and (5) promoting sustainable, nutrition-sensitive food systems. Within Uganda's evolving agricultural landscape, RISE positions young people as future Agripreneurship and institutional leaders capable of influencing policy, strengthening farmer organisations, and driving inclusive rural development.
